extract: RBAC Registry + ABAC Repository Permissions mode supports Container Registry Repository Reader with optional repository conditions; does not honor legacy AcrPull/AcrPush/AcrDelete. RBAC Registry Permissions uses AcrPull for pulls. Repository Reader does not grant registry catalog listing. In ABAC mode Owner/Contributor/Reader control-plane permissions do not grant repository data access.
